title: Cap. V Obj. 8 Sol: adults not saved or predestinated without faith — but distinguish praedestinare/servare
pass_a_gloss: Solution. We acknowledge that no adult can be saved without faith, and that because the Divine will has so ordained; which ordination of his will he has opened and promulgated in the Gospel. We also concede that no adult is predestinated to be saved without faith. But this can be taken ambiguously; it therefore needs a distinct explanation. Since therefore to predestinate denotes an internal act in the secret of the Divine mind, to Save an external effect wrought in the man: we say that no one is predestinated to be saved without consideration of antecedent faith, under the reason of a means unto the production of that external effect: but we deny that no one is predestinated to be saved without consideration of antecedent faith under the reason of a motive, unto the production of that internal act.
pass_b_english: Sol. We grant no adult can be saved without faith — so God's will ordained, and he opened that ordination in the Gospel. We also grant no adult is predestinated to be saved without faith. But that can be taken ambiguously and needs distinct explanation. Predestinating denotes an internal act in the secret of the divine mind; Saving denotes an external effect wrought in the man. So: no one is predestinated to be saved without considering antecedent faith as a means to producing that external effect — but we deny that no one is predestinated to be saved without considering antecedent faith as a motive for producing that internal act.
source_text: Sol. Agnoscimus, adultorum neminem absque fide salvari posse, idque quia Divina voluntas ita ordinavit; quam voluntatis suae ordinationem in Evangelio patefecit et promulgavit. Concedimus etiam, neminem adultorum praedestinari salvandum sine fide. Sed hoc ambigue sumi potest; eget itaque distincta explicatione. Cum igitur praedestinare denotat actum internum in arcano mentis Divinae, Servare effectum externum in homine operatum: dicimus, neminem praedestinari salvandum absque fidei antecedentis consideratione, sub ratione medii ad productionem effectus illius externi: sed negamus, neminem praedestinari salvandum absque consideratione fidei antecedentis sub ratione motivi, ad productionem actus illius interni.
